## Loading the data
```{r}
meta <- read.table("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/CombinedMetadata_CompleteAtlases_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.txt")

## Correct species GuineaPig to Guinea Pig
meta$species[meta$species == "GuineaPig"] <- "Guinea Pig"

## Fixing the order of species
meta$species <- factor(x = meta$species, levels = c("Mouse", "Rat", "Guinea Pig", "Rabbit", "Human", "Marmoset"))
```
## QC plot 1d: percentage mitochondrial reads
```{r}
p <- ggplot(meta, aes(x = orig.ident, y = percent.mt, fill = species)) + geom_violin() + ylab("% mitochondrial reads") + theme(panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.title.y =  element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color = "black"), axis.text = element_text(size =  12), legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_rect(color="white", fill="white", size=1.5, linetype="solid"), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"), panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines")) + facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)
p1 <- p + stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="point", size=2)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/1d_CompleteAtlases_PercentMito.png", plot = p1, width = 20, height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/1d_CompleteAtlases_PercentMito.pdf", plot = p1, width = 20, height = 4)

rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "meta"))
```

## Plotting proportions of cell classes per cell type
## Cell class proportions per species
```{r}
## Reloading the metadata
meta <- read.table("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/CombinedMetadata_CompleteAtlases_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.txt")

## Computing proportions
mouse_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Mouse") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Mouse"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Mouse")

rat_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Rat") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Rat"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Rat")

human_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Human") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk Sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Human"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Human")

marmoset_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Marmoset") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Marmoset"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Marmoset")

rabbit_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Rabbit") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "Rabbit"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Rabbit")

guineapig_df <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "GuineaPig") %>% dplyr::select(cell.class) %>% mutate(cell.class.final = case_when(cell.class == "OtherBloodCells" ~ "Other blood cells", cell.class %in% c("DecidualCells") ~ "Decidual cells", cell.class == "YolkSac" ~ "Yolk sac", cell.class == "StromalCells" ~ "Stromal", .default = cell.class)) %>% pull(cell.class.final) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename("Cell_class" = ".") %>% mutate("Frequency" = Freq / nrow(meta %>% dplyr::filter(species == "GuineaPig"))) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% dplyr::mutate("Species" = "Guinea Pig")

## Compiling altogether
df <- rbind(mouse_df, rat_df, rabbit_df, marmoset_df, human_df, guineapig_df)

df$Species <- factor(df$Species, levels = c("Mouse", "Rat", "Guinea Pig", "Rabbit", "Marmoset", "Human"))

## Defining color palette
palette <- c("Leukocytes" = "#1F78B4",
             "Other blood cells" = "#6A3D9A",
             "Decidual cells" = "#E6AB02",
             "Endothelial" = "#C71585",
              "Stromal" = "#A6761D",
             "Yolk sac" = "#969696",
             "Trophoblast" = "#00BFC4")

## Plotting proportions
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Species, y = Frequency, fill = Cell_class)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + ylab("Fraction of the atlas") + theme(panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), plot.title = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", colour = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 37.5, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 14, colour = "black"), axis.text = element_text(size =  14, colour = "black"), legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title.x = element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values = palette) + labs(fill = NULL)

# Save figure
ggsave("Visuals/1f_CompleteAtlases_CellClassProportions.png", plot = p1, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Visuals/1f_CompleteAtlases_CellClassProportions.pdf", plot = p1, width = 10, height = 9)
```
